children: ("Magma" or the "Company") provided an update on the advancement of its Niñobamba silver-gold project ("Niñobamba" or the "Project"), located in the Department of Ayacucho, Peru.

The Company continues its engagement with two local communities with the objective of establishing the necessary surface access arrangements to allow Magma to undertake systematic exploration of the extensive high-sulphidation and low-sulphidation epithermal silver-gold system identified along the approximately 8-kilometre mineralized corridor. Magma views the establishment and maintenance of strong, mutually beneficial relationships with its host communities as an essential component of the long-term advancement of the Project.

The Company has already received the necessary permits to allow drilling on the Jorimina property once the relevant community access agreement has been concluded. While these discussions continue, the Company is taking steps to acquire additional historical data, advance exploration planning, and expand the team required to conduct efficient and professional exploration of Niñobamba.
Over C$14.5 million has been spent in prior exploration activities by previous operators including Newmont, AngloGold Ashanti, Bear Creek and Rio Silver.

Over 9,700 meters of drilling completed with historical result highlights of 72.3m of 1.19 g/t Au starting at 53m depth; 87 g/t silver over a drilled interval of 130m starting from a depth of 9m; 54 g/t silver over a drilled interval of 96m starting from 23m; and trenching by Rio Silver revealed a new gold-silver zone returning 56m of 1.03 g/t gold and 98.9 g/t silver and 21.77m of 1.32 g/t gold and 102.46 g/t silver ending in mineralization.
Approximately 4,196 hectares owned or held under option (100% interest).

Four old mine workings located immediately north of Joramina Central were sampled, with 5 samples averaging 5.32 g/t Au and 149.7 g/t Ag. Results ranged from 0.50 g/t to 14.56 g/t Au and 18.8 g/t to 329.5 g/t Ag.

Stephen Barley, Executive Chairman and CEO of Magma Silver, stated

"Niñobamba represents a compelling opportunity to use modern exploration techniques to systematically advance a large, historically explored silver-gold system and the potential for a copper/lead/zinc porphyry system. Considerable exploration work and capital have already been invested in the Project by some of the world's leading mining companies, providing Magma with a technical foundation from which to advance the Project. Our immediate strategy is to continue advancing our background knowledge and team while working constructively with the communities toward appropriate and mutually beneficial access agreements. We believe this approach allows us to continue moving the Project forward while building the community relationships necessary for its long-term success."
SAMPLING, HISTORICAL DATA AND ADJACENT PROPERTIES

Grab, chip and composite samples are selective by nature and are not necessarily representative of mineralization hosted on the Project. Samples from the Company's Phase 1 and Phase 2 programs were analyzed by fire assay at Independent Mining Lab Services, Huancayo, Peru, with every tenth sample submitted to Inspectorate Services Peru SAC, an independent laboratory in Lima, Peru for check assay. Historical results referenced in this news release were generated by previous operators; the Company's Qualified Person has not independently verified the historical data, which should not be relied upon until confirmed by the Company. Mineralization on adjacent or nearby properties, including ground held by BHP, is not necessarily indicative of mineralization on the Project.

Magma Silver Corp. is a natural resources exploration company focused on acquiring, exploring, developing, and operating precious metal mining projects. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange ("MGMA"), OTCQB ("MAGMF"), and Frankfurt Exchange ("BC21"), the Company's primary focus is on exploring and developing the advanced Niñobamba silver-gold project in the mining-friendly country of Peru. Niñobamba spans an 8 km mineralized corridor in a prolific geological belt of a high-sulphidation and low-sulphidation epithermal system. Extensive exploration by Newmont Corporation, AngloGold Ashanti Limited, Bear Creek Mining Corporation, and Rio Silver Inc. has demonstrated significant resource potential, with over C$14.5 million invested to date. Magma Silver is advancing its Niñobamba project using modern geological modelling and a strategic development plan. The property has excellent infrastructure, and the Company is building relationships with local communities and expanding its technical team.
